rules.fact: $15,000 total budget; no sponsorship; nothing free (gifted parts must be priced at fair market value); car must be stock when bought, then anything goes
Fuel system safety rule: team must inventory/price a cheap (e.g. Amazon) fuel system, then may substitute the nicer hoses/fittings normally used, at the cheap price
Brake safety rule: a complete paid-for brake set can be traded for a set of TBM brakes (cars expected to reach ~160 mph); upgraded master cylinder counted as part of the brake upgrade
Ryan acts as budget referee/moderator ('red marker') verifying invoices and setting fair market values
